note: Axis 3 (Liquidity & Exit), single producer. The axis is the worse of executable venue depth and primary redemption. Pool TVL is context only and is never substituted for executable depth.

depth.slippage_convention: Per-chain routed exact-input reUSD -> native USDC quotes. USD rung sizes are converted to reUSD with the dated external reUSD/USD mid. Within each chain, marginal impact is execution-rate deterioration from that chain's smallest successful rung; signed cost, with -200bps as the crossing threshold. No cross-chain scalar is computed because holdings cannot be assumed movable between chains at zero cost or delay.
depth.basis: No canonical scalar 2% depth is published. The tested rungs were $100, $1K, $5K, $10K, $25K, $50K, $100K, $250K, $500K, $1M, $2M, $5M, and $10M on each registered chain. Ethereum cleared the threshold through every successful tested rung up to $10M (the $1M request failed); Base crossed between $100 and $1K; Avalanche crossed between $5K and $10K. Arbitrum had no indexed pool and its only router responses were limit-order dust returning about 0.91 USDC for a $100 input, with a zero router input mark, so they are retained as invalid quotes rather than executable depth. A single asset-level number would require a declared chain-allocation or bridging convention that is not present in liquidity/1. Pool TVL is context only and is never executable depth.
depth.bias_measures: per_chain_smallest_successful_rung; Arbitrum excluded as economically invalid

denomination_scope.measured_leg: reUSD -> native USDC, independently on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and Avalanche
denomination_scope.input_notional: USD, converted to chain-local reUSD with the external CoinGecko aggregate mid
denomination_scope.output_denomination: native USDC tokens, valued at $1 for ladder comparison
denomination_scope.exit_cost_scope: Chain-local routed swap only; the measurement does not assume that a holder can move reUSD inventory to the deepest chain without cost, delay, or bridge risk.

anchor.fair_value_source: CoinGecko API external USD aggregate mid for re-protocol-reusd; used for input-notional sizing only

quote.method: KyberSwap GET /api/v1/routes exact-input routed quote, queried separately on each chain
quote.failed_size_note: Ethereum's $1M request returned no route while larger rungs succeeded; it is a quote failure, not a depth boundary. Arbitrum responses were economically invalid and are not threshold-clearing rungs.

rungs.reason: Only KyberSwap limit-order dust was returned; proceeds are about 0.91% of input value and router amountInUsd implies a zero input mark.
Same economically invalid limit-order-only route; not executable depth evidence.

primary_exit.capacity_basis: No reUSD primary-redemption contract, live capacity, or chain-specific redemption path was verified in this measurement; reUSDe's quarterly WindowRedemption terms are not copied to reUSD.
primary_exit.note: Primary exit is deliberately unrated rather than inferred from the sibling reUSDe tranche.

enumeration.source: CoinGecko contract registry; GeckoTerminal token-pool search; DefiLlama yields pool search; DexTracker live KyberSwap routed queries
enumeration.chain_count_note: All four chains in the supplied reUSD registry were searched: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and Avalanche. Ethereum, Base, and Avalanche returned indexed swap venues. Arbitrum returned no GeckoTerminal pools and only economically invalid KyberSwap limit-order dust; this is recorded as nothing found by the searched sources, not proof that no on-chain venue exists. Solana, Ink, and BNB Chain appeared in the contemporaneous CoinGecko platform list but were outside the supplied four-chain registry and were not searched; they are explicitly not absence findings.

Arbitrum.reason: No indexed pools; router returned limit-order dust only.

enumeration.completeness: Complete for the four-chain registry supplied in the handoff; not a complete census of every chain reported by CoinGecko at measurement time.

axis_binding_constraint.basis: Neither a single cross-chain secondary-depth scalar nor reUSD primary-redemption capacity was established. The file therefore replaces the unverifiable $10M substitute with a declared unrated result while retaining the measured chain-local evidence.
